versions.content: Rte_IFeedback API may only be used by the RunnableEntity s that describe its usage The Rte_IFeedback API shall only be used by a RunnableEntity that either has a VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role referring to the VariableDataPrototype or is triggered by a DataWriteCompletedEvent referring to the VariableAccess which in turn references the VariableDataPrototype .
